Composition API: import set, del.description:
Vue 2.7+. Named-import equivalents of `Vue.set()` / `Vue.delete()`, for adding or removing reactive properties without the global `Vue` object.
Removed in Vue 3 — its reactivity system does not need them.

Composition API: import h.description:
Vue 2.7+. The render function helper, usable outside `render(h)`.
Unlike Vue 3, it must still be called during a component's render phase.

Composition API: import PropType.description: Vue 2.7+ (TS only). Type helper for annotating complex `props` types.
